idea-plugin.name: LeakLens - Memory Leak Detector & AI Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
LeakLens is a professional-grade memory leak detector that bridges the gap between the Android Profiler and LeakCanary. It brings the power of the Shark Heap Analysis engine directly into your IDE, enhanced with AI-powered fix suggestions.

Watch the 2-minute demo

The Ultimate Memory Tool for Modern Android

LeakLens provides a seamless "detect-analyze-fix" workflow without ever leaving your IDE.

✨ Key Highlights

  • 🤖 AI Fix Assistant: Instantly translate complex, cryptic leak traces into actionable Kotlin/Java code fixes using Gemini or GPT-4.
  • 🛡️ Preventive UAST Inspections: Catch 6+ critical leak patterns (Static Activity Refs, Anonymous Inner Classes, etc.) as you write code.
  • 🔍 SDK-Free Analysis: No project setup required. Capture heap dumps via ADB and analyze them host-side without adding dependencies to your APK.
  • 📊 Real-time Monitor : An integrated memory graph to track JVM Heap usage with configurable auto-dump thresholds.
  • 🎯 Precision Navigation: Click any part of a leak trace to jump directly to the problematic line in your source code.

🚀 How to Get Started

  1. Connect your debuggable Android device or emulator.
  2. Open the LeakLens tool window (bottom tab).
  3. Click "Dump Heap Now" to capture and analyze your first leak.

Building high-quality Android apps shouldn't be slowed down by memory leaks. If LeakLens saves you time, please consider leaving a 5-star review!
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.0 — SonarLint-style Real-time Detection & Stability

  • SonarLint-style Analysis: Potential leaks (Static Fields, Inner Classes, Context leaks) are now detected as you type with instant squiggly lines and gutter markers.
  • Status Bar Widget: A new counter in the IDE status bar keeps you updated on total project leaks at all times.
  • New Specialized Inspections: Added checks for Hilt Scope Mismatch, WorkManager Context leaks, and Unsafe Flow collection.
  • Unified UX: Real-time static issues now merge seamlessly with deep heap analysis results in the tool window.
  • Critical Compatibility: Fixed binary incompatibilities and INTERNAL_API_USAGES for IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate and future platform releases (2025.x/2026.x).
  • API Modernization: Fully resolved all deprecated API warnings (ProcessAdapter, FileSaverDescriptor).

0.1.9 (Internal)

  • Internal stability and compatibility improvements.

0.1.8 — Staff Pick Edition (Final Polish)

  • Branding: Refined name and description for better clarity and professional appearance.
  • UI: Added high-quality SVG icons for both Light and Dark IDE themes.
  • Onboarding: Added a direct link to the video demo and improved the "Getting Started" guide.
  • AI: Finalized the "Ask AI" integration across all 6 static inspection types.

0.1.7 — Stability & Documentation Update

  • Build Stability: Resolved CI/Build issues with buildSearchableOptions.
  • Inspection Docs: Added comprehensive HTML descriptions for all 6 LeakLens inspections.
  • Type Safety: Hardened UAST analysis logic to prevent crashes and improve accuracy.
  • Dependency Alignment: Stabilized Kotlin and Plugin SDK versions for Ladybug compatibility.

0.1.6 — Compatibility & CI Stability Update

  • Binary Compatibility: Fixed "Method Not Found" errors by reverting to more compatible ddmlib APIs.
  • CI Fix: Resolved GlobalScope inspection test failures by correcting test data markers.
  • SEO & Name: Refined plugin name to LeakLens - Android Memory Leak Detector & AI Fix Assistant for better search and extraction compatibility.
  • Clean Architecture: Further optimized plugin.xml by removing redundant service registrations.

0.1.4

  • SEO Overhaul: Optimized metadata for search terms like "OOM", "Heap Analysis", and "Android Profiler".
  • Marketplace Compatibility: Fixed plugin description formatting (removed tables) to comply with JetBrains standards.
  • Internal Optimization: Removed redundant service registrations to favor modern @Service annotations.
  • Quick Review: Added "Rate LeakLens" action to the Tools menu for community feedback.
  • Ladybug Support: Verified and improved stability for the latest Android Studio versions.

0.1.2

  • Internal API Fixes: Resolved 15 verification errors to ensure compatibility with JetBrains Marketplace standards.
  • Memory Management: Optimized Kotlin Coroutine scopes and explicit Disposable cleanup for better plugin performance.
  • Gradle Stability: Enhanced support for experimental Gradle and Kotlin JVM versions.

0.1.1

  • UAST Migration: Full support for Kotlin and Java static analysis inspections.
  • UX Polish: New IntelliJ UI DSL 2 implementation for a native Look & Feel.
  • ADB Reliability: Optimized device communication for faster Heap Dump captures.
  • Fix Engine: Added professional headers and formatting to AI-powered fix suggestions.

0.1.0

  • Initial release: Integrated Shark (LeakCanary) engine for real-time Memory Leak detection.
